name: composer-queue
title: Composer Queue
description: The messages queued while a turn runs, on a shelf above a composer: each can be edited (not one marked `editable: false`, e.g. a queued command, with its `icon` before its text), one from elsewhere says where (`from`: another agent or session, by weight before its text, cut to a third of the row, read with it and able to hold a link; over its text in the manager), moved to the top, sent now or removed, and moved by dragging or with Alt+ArrowUp and Alt+ArrowDown, which screen readers hear; past three it shows the first and how many more, and opens a dialog to filter, select, edit, move and remove them all. Shows a message being sent and a paused queue (resume, clear). On a phone, one row over the composer that opens the dialog full screen. The app owns the queue; the shelf asks for changes.
